messages:
deploybot: Scheduled cutover for inference-api at 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z. Feature flag to toggle: `ff.inference.v2.enable`. Ramp plan: 0% -> 5% -> 25% -> 75% -> 100% over ~30m with telemetry gates. Pinning model version for canary. Please ack and announce owners for telemetry, rollback, and release notes.

matt_k: ack. I'll own telemetry and final go/no-go. :white_check_mark: I'll post thresholds.

shreya: ack. I'll watch error rate, latency p95, and token cost delta. Thresholds: 5xx > 0.8% OR p95 + 50ms for two consecutive 5m windows -> pause & rollback.

carla: I'll pin model to v2.0.1 for canary cohort before the first ramp. Command I'll run:```
# pin model for canary cohort
deploybot pin-model inference-api v2.0.1 --cohort canary --note "cutover 2026-03-22"
```

deploybot: Model pin applied: inference-api -> v2.0.1 (cohort=canary).

release-notes-bot: Draft release notes created: https://internal.docs/releases/inference-api/2.0.1 — please review the "compatibility" and "rollback" sections.

sre_oncall: change window reminder 02:00-04:00 UTC. Oncall will be in #eng-oncall. If metrics cross thresholds use `deploybot pause` then `deploybot rollback-tag v1.9.9`. Keep the channel open. :rotating_light:

matt_k: starting soft-attenuate -> 5% in 2m. Commands I'll run:```
# ramp to 5%
redwood-ff toggle ff.inference.v2.enable --set 5% --actor matt_k --note "soft-attenuate canary"
# check telemetry 10m
```

deploybot: Executing `redwood-ff toggle` -> ff.inference.v2.enable set to 5%. Ramp step complete. Monitoring hooks engaged.

shreya: :eyes: watching errors now. Posting early metrics in 5m.

matt_k: If green at 10m, move to 25%. If any gate trips, we revert flag and run `deploybot rollback-tag v1.9.9` and demote canary.

carla: noted. After 25% I'll unpin canary if stable and allow wider rollout.

deploybot: Telemetry check at +10m: error_rate=0.12%, p95 latency +8ms, token_cost +0.4%. All gates green. Proceed to 25% in 2m unless objections.

matt_k: green, proceeding to 25%. :rocket:

shreya: will keep watch for the next 20m. If we see error spikes or user complaints, we hold and escalate.

sre_oncall: copying rollback playbook here: https://internal.playbooks/rollback-guides/inference-api. Quick checklist: `deploybot pause`, `deploybot rollback-tag v1.9.9`, notify infra to revert any model pins.

matt_k: tagging @release-notes-bot to add canary observations to the notes.

release-notes-bot: Added canary observations section. Anyone, please add any noteworthy behavior (prompt-level regressions, hallucination cases) before final publish.

carla: publishing final pin-release artifact and manifest after 75% stage. I'll post the manifest link to this thread.

matt_k: thanks team. Keep this thread as the canonical runbook for this cutover. If we need an emergency rollback, call it in #eng-releases and @sre_oncall.

deploybot: Final summary logged. Cutover in progress. Steps recorded under runbook id RB-2026-031-1645."
